name: html-product-grid-below-image-only-threshold
description: Leaves a small (3-card) grid of name + one-time price + photo cards unflagged when no card carries schema.org evidence or a cart control, since a small image-only-qualified count is a more common false positive (e.g. a pricing/plan comparison with photos) than a real catalog.

source_reference.notes: Companion negative case for html-product-grid-catalog-image-without-cart.json: identical card shape, one card short of CommerceFallbackReporter::MIN_IMAGE_ONLY_QUALIFIED_CARDS. Proves the conservative repetition floor, not just the per-card structural quad.

legacy_comparison.reason: This upstream commerce-recognition fixture has no downstream legacy comparison.
